title: Amariah Lodiong shares faith with new single "Africa"
htmlContent: Amariah Lodiong, a rising gospel child singer, has released "Africa", a new single that is a spiritual battle cry and a record, laced with an Afrobeat vibe. Infusing the rhythm and harmony of her Kuku Tribe culture in South Sudan with Americana sounds from Mississippi, USA, Amariah adds a beautiful, fresh, authentic, celebratory, yet deeply stirring sound. "Africa" bravely addresses spiritual warfare and the victory over evil, and the track basks in joy, coupling heartfelt lyrics with rhythms that compel you to lift your hands high. https://open.spotify.com/track/5AXMNmNxCq86BGPHtmPEuk The strength of this song lies in its uplifting nature, while also prompting listeners to reflect on the concepts of resilience, faith, and hope. "Africa" is less a song and more of a movement. Every beat has an upward thrust, every chorus a lifting of hearts. If you like gospel, Afrobeat, or are just looking for music that's sure to move the soul, then "Africa" is a must-hear. Amariah Lodiong proves the next generation of gospel voices is here to impact the world, one powerful song at a time. Follow Amariah Lodiong on Instagram, Facebook
